legend: You have an intricate system of n$$$n$$$ circular gears connected in a line, with their centers fixed in n$$$n$$$ corresponding axles. The i$$$i$$$-th axle is fixed on the wall at coordinate xi$$$x_i$$$ on the (imaginary) number line.

However, a massive earthquake just hit, and all gears have fallen to the ground, leaving the axles hanging on the wall. Given the radii of the n$$$n$$$ gears ri$$$r_i$$$ and the coordinates of the axles, you are asked to reinstall the system by putting the gears back onto their original places.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤500000$$$1 \leq n \leq 500 \: 000$$$).
The second line of the input contains n$$$n$$$ integers x1,x2,…,xn$$$x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n$$$ (1≤xi≤1016$$$1 \leq x_i \leq 10^{16}$$$), the positions of the axles in increasing order.
The third line of the input contains n$$$n$$$ integers r1,r2,…,rn$$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n$$$ (1≤ri≤109$$$1 \leq r_i \leq 10^9$$$), the radii of the n$$$n$$$ gears.
output: Output n$$$n$$$ numbers s1,s2,…,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n$$$ which indicate the correct placement of the gears on their axle. More specifically, si$$$s_i$$$ should be the radius of the gear that will be placed on the i$$$i$$$-th axle from the left. For the placement to be valid, every two neighbouring gears must be touching, and s$$$s$$$ should be a permutation of r$$$r$$$.
It is guaranteed that for all test cases, a solution exists. If multiple solutions exists, you may output any of them.

legend.ai: 你有一个由 n$$$n$$$ 个首尾相连的圆形齿轮组成的复杂系统，它们的中心固定在 n$$$n$$$ 个对应的轴上。第 i$$$i$$$ 个轴固定在墙上，其坐标为数轴(虚构)上的 xi$$$x_i$$$。
然而，一场强烈的地震刚刚袭来，所有齿轮都掉到了地上，只留下悬挂在墙上的轴。给定 n$$$n$$$ 个齿轮的半径 ri$$$r_i$$$ 以及各个轴的坐标，你需要将齿轮重新安装回它们原来的位置，以恢复整个系统。

input.ai: 输入的第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 x1,x2,…,xn$$$x_1, x_2, \ldots, x_n$$$ (1≤xi≤1016$$$1 \leq x_i \leq 10^{16}$$$)，表示按递增顺序排列的车轴位置。
输入的第三行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 r1,r2,…,rn$$$r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n$$$ (1≤ri≤109$$$1 \leq r_i \leq 10^9$$$)，表示 n$$$n$$$ 个齿轮的半径。

output.ai: 输出 n$$$n$$$ 个数 s1,s2,…,sn$$$s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n$$$，表示齿轮在车轴上的正确放置方式。更具体地说，si$$$s_i$$$ 应为从左侧数第 i$$$i$$$ 个车轴上放置的齿轮半径。为了使放置有效，任意两个相邻齿轮都必须相互接触，并且 s$$$s$$$ 应为 r$$$r$$$ 的一个排列。
对于所有测试用例，保证存在解。如果存在多个解，你可以输出任意一个。
